Lina (Support): Escalating: Acrolytics trial (tenant=acro-try-3) can't finish onboarding. Bulk embed jobs are getting intermittent 502/504. Customer has a public demo in ~3h and renewal check in 6 days. Need CS lead + immediate comms + short mitigation. :rotating_light:
Tomas (CS): Taking this. Can you drop the error sample + tenant quota numbers? I'll set a 20m remediation slot and draft an external note.
Lina (Support): Error snippet:
```
POST /v1/embeddings -> 504 gateway_timeout
{"error":"edge_timeout","request_id":"req_e7a1"}
Trace: embed-proxy -> prefix-cache -> worker-queue-timeout
```
Lina (Support): Also seeing bursts from their CI: ~90 parallel ingest threads.
Marco (Eng): Probable cause: cache eviction + worker saturation due to parallel prefix writes. Quick mitigations: 1) temporarily route tenant to a low-util pool, 2) cap tenant concurrency, 3) enable fallback to a smaller model variant for demo flows. I can flip routing and apply a cap now. Command: `redwoodctl tenant set-route acro-try-3 --pool=eu-west-lowload`
Asha (AM): Demo is public at 11:00 CET. If we don't fix, risk to renewal. They're evaluating multi-seat plans contingent on demo success. I'll join the customer call.
Tomas (CS): Comms plan: (A) Immediate outbound: short status email + 15m triage with Support+Eng in 10m. (B) If mitigation holds: 30m remediation session with customer and offer $400 credit + free enablement call. (C) Post-call: update renewal brief and set proactive outreach in 4 days. Asha ok on credit & enablement? :memo:
Asha (AM): Approved $400 credit + complimentary 1-hr enablement. Use: "We're sorry for the disruption; we've applied a workaround and credited $400 as goodwill." Approved. :+1:
Lina (Support): Customer accepted a 15m triage in 12 minutes. Shared SSO admin and sample manifest.
Marco (Eng): Route switched and concurrency cap applied. Error rate dropping on dashboards (5% -> 0.6%). I'll also enable a demo-safe fallback model for requests with header `x-demo-mode: true` to reduce backend pressure. Holding changes for 3 hours.
PagerBot: Incident logged INC-2067-900; severity=high; assignees=Tomas (CS), Marco (Eng); created_at=1999123465
Tomas (CS): On remediation call now. Goals: validate demo path, hand over sample ingest scripts, confirm SSO.
Lina (Support): Customer asked for a sample Node + Python ingest snippet and an SSO checklist. I'll add those to the ticket.
Marco (Eng): Follow-ups: open PR for batching guard on prefix writes, add tenant-specific rate limiter, and schedule potential hotfix window tonight if needed. I'll revert route after 24h stable.
Tomas (CS): Call complete  workaround validated; demo path exercised. Customer appreciated quick response but wants a short tech review before demo. Sending remediation summary + credit notice now and scheduling review in 2 hours. Marking renewal as watch.
Asha (AM): I'll update the renewal brief with mitigation notes and reach out proactively in 4 days. If demo goes well, we'll move to upsell cadence. :eyes:
Lina (Support): Ticket will stay open until follow-up confirmed. Logs + CI job timeline attached.
Tomas (CS): CRM note to paste: "Acrolytics trial experienced intermittent 502/504 during bulk ingest due to prefix-cache eviction triggered by concurrent CI ingest. Temporary route to low-util pool + concurrency cap + demo-model fallback mitigated issue during validation. Actions: $400 credit + 1-hr enablement offered; SSO & ingest scripts delivered; eng fix queued (batching guard + rate limiter). Renewal flagged for proactive outreach in 4 days. Contacts: Tomas (CS), Asha (AM)."
PagerBot: INC-2067-900 status=monitoring; last_update=1999123490
